properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] DNS Private Resolver: Custom Forwarding Rules for On-Prem DNS
properties.description: Audits DNS Private Resolver forwarding rulesets to ensure custom forwarding rules exist for on-premises domain resolution. FedRAMP High requires secure name/address resolution (SC-20) and boundary protection for DNS traffic (SC-21). Forwarding rules must be configured to route on-premises domain queries to designated on-prem DNS servers via ExpressRoute or VPN, ensuring split-horizon DNS resolution within the trusted network boundary.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance for forwarding rulesets without rules. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
